name: mgh
description: The AWS Migration Hub API methods help to obtain server and application migration status and integrate your resource-specific migration tool by providing a programmatic interface to Migration Hub.

subcommands.name: associate-created-artifact
subcommands.description: Associates a created artifact of an AWS cloud resource, the target receiving the migration, with the migration task performed by a migration tool.

subcommands.name: associate-discovered-resource
subcommands.description: Associates a discovered resource ID from Application Discovery Service with a migration task.

subcommands.name: associate-source-resource
subcommands.description: Associates a source resource with a migration task.

subcommands.name: create-progress-update-stream
subcommands.description: Creates a progress update stream which is an AWS resource used for access control as well as a namespace for migration task names that is implicitly linked to your AWS account.

subcommands.name: delete-progress-update-stream
subcommands.description: Deletes a progress update stream, including all of its tasks, which was previously created as an AWS resource used for access control.

subcommands.name: describe-application-state
subcommands.description: Gets the migration status of an application.

subcommands.name: describe-migration-task
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of all attributes associated with a specific migration task.

subcommands.name: disassociate-created-artifact
subcommands.description: Disassociates a created artifact of an AWS resource with a migration task performed by a migration tool that was previously associated.

subcommands.name: disassociate-discovered-resource
subcommands.description: Disassociate an Application Discovery Service discovered resource from a migration task.

subcommands.name: disassociate-source-resource
subcommands.description: Removes the association between a source resource and a migration task.

subcommands.name: import-migration-task
subcommands.description: Registers a new migration task which represents a server, database, etc., being migrated to AWS by a migration tool.

subcommands.name: list-application-states
subcommands.description: Lists all the migration statuses for your applications.

subcommands.name: list-created-artifacts
subcommands.description: Lists the created artifacts attached to a given migration task in an update stream.

subcommands.name: list-discovered-resources
subcommands.description: Lists discovered resources associated with the given MigrationTask.

subcommands.name: list-migration-task-updates
subcommands.description: This is a paginated API that returns all the migration-task states for the specified MigrationTaskName and ProgressUpdateStream.

subcommands.name: list-migration-tasks
subcommands.description: Lists all, or filtered by resource name, migration tasks associated with the user account making this call.

subcommands.name: list-progress-update-streams
subcommands.description: Lists progress update streams associated with the user account making this call.

subcommands.name: list-source-resources
subcommands.description: Lists all the source resource that are associated with the specified MigrationTaskName and ProgressUpdateStream.

subcommands.name: notify-application-state
subcommands.description: Sets the migration state of an application.

subcommands.name: notify-migration-task-state
subcommands.description: Notifies Migration Hub of the current status, progress, or other detail regarding a migration task.

subcommands.name: put-resource-attributes
subcommands.description: Provides identifying details of the resource being migrated so that it can be associated in the Application Discovery Service repository.
